description: When the AI controller possesses a pawn, it runs the Behavior Tree its variable VariableName holds (BehaviorTreePath by default) with Run Behavior Tree, which also starts the tree's Blackboard. A pawn placed in the level is possessed as the level starts, and a spawned one when it spawns, so long as its Auto Possess AI and AI Controller Class point here.

placeholders.VariableName: The variable: a BehaviorTree variable the controller already has, else DefaultBehaviorTree.
